roles.note: monochrome on white; the pale ice-blue is an imagery GRADE (desaturate + blow-out toward white), not a UI token. No accent hue, no dark mode.

type.notes: Near-flat scale: 12px caption/label, 15px and 16px body, NO display tier (no measurable h1). Hierarchy from weight (700 keyword emphasis) + uppercase + positive tracking + position, not size. Labels uppercase, positively tracked (mono-caps technical signature).

space.notes: Cosmic section rhythm: 128px/112px padding-block between bands; tiny 2px intra-label spacing. Contrast of micro vs macro spacing is the rhythm.

notes: Normalized from raw/praxis.json + screenshots/frames. fg #101010 taken from the focus-outline color (true text reads ~black); muted is inferred for tiny secondary labels. image-tint records the bleached-blue imagery grade, deliberately NOT a color token. in-view-fade is probe-inferred (IO targets + fadeIn keyframe), frame-unconfirmed (0 entrance reveals captured). Site is otherwise near-static: only confirmed scroll effect is the header pin; one ambient <video>. The 212 rAF / 10 mousemove footprint is consistent with subtle cursor parallax but no hover/cursor effect was captured — omitted as unconfirmed.
